title: Addon Outbound Task Dispatch Credentials
problem: Nako could already dispatch Addon Tasks directly, but the direct-dispatch path previously passed no outbound credential, so addons that declare AddonAuth::Bearer or AddonAuth::SharedSecret needed a safe host-owned storage and resolution boundary.

evidence.summary: Current direct dispatch still passes no outbound credential, while the Addon client already knows how to emit bearer and shared-secret headers when given a token.
Addon registrations now persist outbound_task_dispatch_secret_env, the Admin registration summary exposes the env reference, and the server resolves it with safe missing-env diagnostics.

Direct dispatch now resolves host-owned outbound credentials for bearer and shared-secret addons, injects the matching header into addon-client calls, and fails safely when the secret reference cannot be resolved.

Closed the lane after fresh formatting, compile, Addon client, focused direct-dispatch, broad server addon, and diff gates passed. Vault or secret-provider integration remains a separate follow-on only if env-backed references prove too narrow.

continue_policy.notes: The outbound credential storage/resolution and direct dispatch injection lane is complete. If env-backed references prove too narrow, split a separate vault/provider follow-on instead of widening host-owned dispatch.
